title: Eric Dale is fired – Margin Call (2011)
summary: A scene from the 2011 film Margin Call in which risk head Eric Dale is laid off by HR and hands a USB stick to a young analyst. It shows a scripted, impersonal corporate firing.
why: Referenced as the canonical depiction of mass layoffs and canned HR scripts whenever layoffs come up.

quote.text: Reminded me of this scene where Eric Dale was getting let go and HR was regurgitating canned script.
